content: Ramesh Tiwari follows up with customer Rohan Ahuja regarding a revised auto policy quote. Rohan is satisfied with the premium but expresses concern about the lapse fee. Ramesh checks the system and offers an additional 5% discount on the lapse fee conditional on upfront payment. Rohan agrees to the deal and decides to proceed with the policy reinstatement.

action_items: Process policy reinstatement with an additional 5% discount on the lapse fee for upfront premium payment
